data.long_meaning: The name Llywellyn means 'Lion like God'. It is a Welsh name with a rich history and cultural significance. In Welsh mythology, Llywellyn was a famous prince who ruled over South Wales during the Middle Ages. He is remembered for his strength, courage, and wisdom. The name Llywellyn carries the meaning “Lion like God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Llywellyn usually hope their child will grow to embody lion like god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Llywellyn carries deep cultural significance in Welsh history. Llywellyn ap Gruffudd was a Welsh prince who led several rebellions against English rule in the late 13th century. He is known for his charisma, military genius, and skill in diplomacy. His legacy continues to inspire the Welsh people, and the name Llywellyn is still cherished as a symbol of Welsh pride.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Llywellyn lies in its roots as a name meaning 'Lion like God'. In Christian theology, the lion is often used as a symbol of courage, strength, and Christ himself. By giving a child the name Llywellyn, parents may be expressing their hope that their child will embody these qualities - that they will be a lion among people and, in the spirit of Christ, a courageous and strong leader who inspires others. Additionally, the name Llywellyn could also be seen as a reminder of the presence and power of God in the lives of those who bear the name.
